source.name: Sportcal (GlobalData) – Juventus name WhiteBIT as sleeve sponsor
source.quote: The deal will run through the 2025-26, 2026-27, and 2027-28 seasons and is understood to be worth around €5 million ($5.8 million) annually.

note: Press estimate ('understood to be worth around'); WhiteBIT replaces Azimut as sleeve sponsor.
